title: Planter-Raj to Swaraj: Freedom Struggle and Electoral Politics in Assam 1826-1947
author: Dr. Amalendu Guha
description: Authoritative economic and political history of colonial Assam, documenting the transitions of Upper Assam agrarian communities, tea plantations, land tenure systems, and the preservation of tribal autonomy among the Tai Khamyang and allied groups.
